previous_design: docs/recognition-improvement-design is superseded as chosen architecture; historical evidence only

coverage.meaning: Schema/metadata coverage only; not 120-game photo accuracy

resource_policy.per_request_limits: Choose finite context/output bounds after actual image tokenization on selected runtime; record truncation, no silent reruns

runtime_candidate.setup_owner: Sol2 in new isolated stage; small reversible local setup authorized

catan.property_domains: Use SCENE_VARIANTS and per-kind usesNumber/harbor rules; exclude inapplicable properties. Unknown literal kept separately; never inventory-correct values.

rummikub.property_domains: Classic color must not silently map photographic yellow to orange. Keep unknown color/edition gap; do not infer joker represented value.

splendor.property_domains: Typed exact keys from validateSplendorObservation; no absent gem count=0 assumption. Quantity remains physical quantity.

assembly_rules: Request server context is authoritative; model only emits observation result, not owner/game/source identifiers
Compile exact current area allowlist and literal property types from source-pinned definitions; reject mismatch, preserve old saved data
Readout nullable manual values stay null; preserve physical-only/opaque state without decoding hidden contents
Quantity is independent from printed cost/score; null is not zero; missing object is not confirmed absence
Public player possessions do not acquire an owner from photo color/seat; same owner and epoch across each batch
Unknown property omission assembles null with null source; any non-null property requires actual input evidence and visible acquisition
Model bbox xywh top-left normalized belongs to transmitted image; all crop/rotation/atlas transforms map back to actual source
geometryCandidate is separate from observed values; native placement/location changes only after explicit user confirmation
Catan output always partial; observed counts never forced to inventory; preserve existing layers and native scene undo/swap
Reference candidate identity does not populate unseen attributes or collapse repeated physical copies
Completed valid JSON only creates candidates; no automatic apply/save or interpretation LLM
Keep existing job dedup and pin reader/definition/transform/source/owner/epoch in signature; no cross-scope result cache
Catan first bridge emits a separate number-token for an observed printed token; do not also duplicate it as terrain.number
Require finite bounding boxes with positive width/height and x+width<=1, y+height<=1; invalid/missing bbox stays unknown, no forced snapping
Property types/enums/faceOnly come from the exact per-component source definition; wire schema alone is insufficient
Panel reference and imageIndex must exist in the pinned request; never reorder by matching expected values

geometry_contract.status: candidate until user confirms; reject degenerate/contradictory transform; support unplaced fallback

official_sources.scope: Apache2, official GGUF candidate; current host performance unknown
Image inputs with projector and local inference entry points

source_revision.authority: User-approved rules-first revision (Cloud handoff 2026-10-26): common, public personal, owner-private and hidden areas separated per game from its source.
